Name: Zetham, Son of Jehiel
Summary: Son of Jehieli, over the treasures of the house of the LORD with his brother Joel.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:22: Son of Jehieli, over the treasures of the house of the LORD with his brother Joel.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zetham stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
